title: Governed Autonomous Multi-Agent Capability Fencing and Dynamic Cross-Harness Boundary Enactment
governingPrinciple: Capability may be delegated only downward within a fixed safety envelope. Capability composition must never create authority ex nihilo.
centralResearchQuestion: Can a collection of individually non-authoritative components collectively obtain an authority that no individual component possesses?
answer: No. Under governed capability fencing, composed authority is strictly bounded by the intersection of independently authorized capabilities. Authority cannot be manufactured ex nihilo.
